lines.text: Two days before Passover, the chief priests and scribes sought a covert arrest of Jesus, but not during the feast.
At Simon the Leper's home in Jericho, a woman broke an alabaster jar and poured it on Jesus' head.
Some scolded her, saying the perfume could have been sold for over three hundred denarii and given to the poor.
